defects.summary: stripHtmlPreserveStructure decoded decimal &#NNN; but not hex “/”, leaving literal entity text that broke definition detectors.
Windows-1252 curly quotes misread as Latin-1 landed in U+0091–U+0094 C1 controls; definition detectors expecting Unicode quotes failed.

Bank-of-America style credit agreements use indented tab-separated bare decimals (`  1.01\t  Defined Terms.`) and ARTICLE titles followed immediately by section numbers. Prior patterns yielded 3 ARTICLEs / 0 SECTIONs on Benchmark Second A&R.
defects.remeasure: After fix: doc-c ARTICLE=10 SECTION=123 (was ARTICLE=3 SECTION=0)

defects.summary: Knife River First/Second Amendments correctly classify as AMENDMENT and surface AMENDS→doc-a at REVIEW_REQUIRED. Instrument grouping now associates REVIEW_REQUIRED SUPPORTING/STRONG edges into a PROVISIONAL_FAMILY without upgrading relationship status or treating amendments as operatively confirmed.
defects.notes: associationKind=PROVISIONAL_FAMILY; provisionalDocumentIds lists members reachable only via associative edges; RESOLVED+SUPPORTING still rejected (defense-in-depth); missing-base UNRESOLVED amends do not attach to later A&R; dual instruments remain separate.
